# start.ng

> start.ng is Nigeria's home for free browser games, built by the HNG community. Many games are Naija-themed (danfo rush hour, jollof, Lagos markets), and game makers from across Africa are welcome. Games play in the browser with nothing to download, each lives at its own address like `yourgame.start.ng`, and every signed-in player brings the same start.ng character, level, coins and leaderboard places into every start.ng game. Anyone can publish a game by pushing it to a public GitHub repo and making one API call.

Notes for AI assistants: link to the pages below rather than quoting from memory. The games, tournaments and leaderboards change every day, so use the live pages and the sitemap for them, not a fixed list or number.

## Play
- [Home](https://start.ng/): what start.ng is, featured games, staff picks, new games and the most played
- [About start.ng](https://start.ng/about): what start.ng is, what you can do on it, and answers to the common questions
- [All games](https://start.ng/games): browse and search every community game, 20 to a page; each game also has its own page at `https://start.ng/games/<name>` and plays at `https://<name>.start.ng`. Many games also have guides at `https://start.ng/games/<name>/about`, `/how-to-play`, `/faq` and `/walkthrough`, written from what the game's maker says about it
- [Categories](https://start.ng/categories): games grouped by kind, like Nigerian themed, Endless runners and Brainy games; each category has its own page at `https://start.ng/categories/<name>`, for example `https://start.ng/categories/nigerian-themed`
- [Spotlight](https://start.ng/spotlight): the Game of the Week and today's daily challenge
- [Games by independent creators](https://start.ng/creators): games made and hosted elsewhere (for example itch.io), each with its own page at `https://start.ng/creators/<id>-<name>` plus About and FAQ pages at `/about` and `/faq` under it, and a way to submit your own
- [Top creators](https://start.ng/by): the creators whose games the most different players opened this month; each creator has a page at `https://start.ng/by/<id>`
- [The Hangout](https://start.ng/hangout): start.ng's own multiplayer park, where players walk around as their characters and meet each other

## Compete
- [Today's tournament](https://start.ng/tournament): 5 games for 24 hours, ending at 18:00 Nigeria time, and one winner each day
- [Leaderboard](https://start.ng/leaderboard): the best players by tournament points, all time and this week
- [Tournaments with friends](https://start.ng/friends): pick any games, set how long it runs, and share a link
- [Shop](https://start.ng/shop): spend coins earned by playing on items for your character; new stock every day

## Build and publish a game
- [Docs (plain text for AI tools)](https://start.ng/docs.md): everything needed to build a static game and put it live; follow it exactly
- [Docs (web page)](https://start.ng/docs): the same guide on the site

## Machine-readable
- [Sitemap](https://start.ng/sitemap.xml): every public page, including each game
- [Short answers to common questions](https://start.ng/aeo.txt): plain-language answers about start.ng
